LanguageData.CC_Felt_Help_Heavy: time, company and good talks (rest alone won't lift a heavy thing)
LanguageData.CC_Felt_WeightLine: A weight of {WEIGHT} on {PAWN_objective}: rest won't ease strain below it, and it lifts over the days.
LanguageData.CC_Felt_WeightLineWhy: A weight of {WEIGHT} from {WHY}: rest won't ease strain below it. It lifts slowly for some days, then faster, and gatherings, good talks and kind words lift it sooner.
LanguageData.CC_Felt_GoodSlower: While strain is on {PAWN_objective}, the good side grows at {PACE} of its pace.
LanguageData.CC_Felt_Tell_Back: {PAWN_nameDef} is coming back from it, no longer worn down.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartActs: Small acts by how they are
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartActs_Tip: Colonists show how they are on the map, now and then, in their free time or at a break in ordinary work: strained, a while in a chair staring at nothing or out looking over the land; worn down, a few minutes outside from their work, pacing at night, a short word at someone; in good heart, humming at work or staying at the table to talk after a meal; in high spirits, singing at work and dancing at a gathering. Each with a line. Never in danger, drafted or downed, never taking anyone from urgent work; one act a colonist in sixteen hours at most and one in the colony in three.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartActs: Strain and the good side show on the map: a while sitting, a step outside, a hum at work, a dance.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartFeelingActs_Tip: A strong feeling is something seen: grief visits the grave or sits where the one lost slept; fear, out after dark, goes in to be near someone; anger says a sharp word or goes through a door and slams it; love sits beside a partner; homesickness talks of home at the evening's fire; joy goes to share it with a friend. Each a short act with its line, in their free time, never in danger. The feelings' small nudges to wishes and moments stay as they are.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartFeelingActs: Grief at the grave, fear indoors after dark, a slammed door, a partner's company.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartSays_Tip: A line over a colonist's head when strain or the good side turns, and now and then while it holds, naming the cause where there is one ("I keep setting a place for Ana."), in their own voice. Shown on the map being looked at, at the same easy pace as everything else said over a head.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartSays: A line when they become worn down or in good heart, and now and then while it lasts.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartSigns: A sign over the head for a strong feeling
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartSigns_Tip: A small sign over a colonist's head when a feeling grows strong (a tear for grief, a bolt for anger, a heart for love), in the feeling's colour, as the game shows a thought; now and then while it holds, once in eight hours at most.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartSigns: A tear, a bolt, a heart over the head while a feeling runs strong.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartMessages_Tip: A message when someone becomes worn down or near breaking, saying why ("Bautista is worn down: the plague and losing Ana."), when they come back from it, and when someone is in good heart or in high spirits, saying what filled it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartMessages: Told when someone is worn down, near breaking, back from it, or in good heart.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_BarHeartLine_Tip: A thin line under each colonist's name on the colonist bar: strain in its band's colour (softer below strained), the good side in green under it, both at once when both, each as long as it is full.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_BarHeartLine: Strain and the good side at a glance, under every name on the bar.
